answer: A comet flashes once; a sybil farmer wants identities that flash in, grab rewards, and vanish. A counterparty-diversity threshold blocks that: each agent must trade with 15 distinct counterparties per epoch, none counting twice. Bridging the canyon between fake clusters costs: renting one partner costs 8 POA, so 1,000 fakes pay 120,000 POA for a 2,000 POA pool. An honest agent on a narrow ledge of one real network pays once and keeps its share.
